scope: MIDI with internal synthesis, system default bank and optional custom PCM SF2/DLS,20extension registration
architecture: Own bounded Standard MIDI format0/1 parser, active16-channel TinySoundFont synth copies sharing bank samples; real per-channel PCM -> existing Player gain/pitch/tempo/reverb/history; no external MIDI device output or fabricated waveform
windows_default: Read HKLM SOFTWARE/Microsoft/DirectMusic GMFilePath; fallback GetSystemDirectory/drivers/gm.dls; do not modify registry setting or redistribute bank
custom_bank: F8 or bottom MIDI bank button; PCM SF2 / mono PCM8/16 DLS1 selection, persisted to local midi-soundfont.txt; new current MIDI restarts after validated change
registration: 20 unique extensions; adds .mid/.midi to14game+4ordinary; prompts updated fromstale14text to20; existing registration consent refreshes revision159 even if executable path same; never overwrite UserChoice or extension default
limits: Internal TinySoundFont/DLS adapter is not identical to Microsoft GS Wavetable/MIDI Mapper audio
No automatic import of third-party MIDI Mapper/VirtualMIDISynth-specific bank settings; choose SF2 manually
Only SMF0/1; PPQN/tempo and SMPTE divisions supported; no SMF2/RMID
PCM SF2 and DLS1 monoPCM8/16; no SF3/SFZ/compressedDLS/DLS2
Custom SF2 modulators, aftertouch, vendor SysEx and some DLS connection routes limited; counters in track metadata
2hour MIDI cap;2s release tail; seeks replay synthesis and may take time on long songs
